definitions.gloss: to shake, to rock, to sway
definitions.explanation: To cause something to move back and forth or side to side. The transitive form of {揺|ゆ}れる.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ゆりかご⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{揺|ゆ}らす。
examples.english: I rock the baby in the cradle.
The wind is shaking the tree branches.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{揺|ゆ}らして⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pair: ⟦{揺|ゆ}れる→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧ (intransitive, to sway). Pattern: Xを{揺|ゆ}らす (shake X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {揺|ゆ}らしている = 'is shaking.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧を{揺|ゆ}らす (sway one's body)
・ゆりかごを{揺|ゆ}らす (rock a cradle)
・⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧を{揺|ゆ}らす (move someone emotionally, lit. shake the heart)
